book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Sikɑdobɑn deemɑ
Yerɑ Fɑlisibɑ kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu ɡɑbu bɑ nɑ Yesun mi sɑɑ Yerusɑlɛmun di, bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ,
mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ ǹ bɛsɛn sikɑdobɑn deemɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ. Domi bɑ ku rɑ niɛ bu sere di.
Yesu bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛ mɑɑ ni, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i rɑ Gusunɔn woodɑ sɑre mɑ i sere bɛɛn deemɑ nɛni.
Domi Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, “A wunɛn tundo kɑ wunɛn mɛro bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ɛyɔ.” U mɑɑ nɛɛ, “Wi u win tundo ǹ kun mɛ win mɛro kɔ̃sɑ ɡerusi bɑ koo nùn ɡowɑ.”
Adɑmɑ bɛɛ i ɡerumɔ mɑ ɡoo ù n win tundo ǹ kun mɛ win mɛro sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, win dukiɑ ye u koo kpĩ u kɑ nùn somi yɑ kuɑ Gusunɔɡiɑ,
n ǹ mɑɑ weenɛ durɔ wi, u win tundo ǹ kun mɛ win mɛro somi. Nɡe mɛyɑ i Gusunɔn ɡɑri tɛɛsimɔ mɑ i bɛɛn deemɑ swĩi.
Murɑfiti bɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ bɛɛn sɔ̃nɑ Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ sɑɑ Esɑin nɔɔn di u nɛɛ,

content.text: “Tɔn beni bɑ mɑn bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ɛmɔ kɑ nɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ ben ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ kɑ mɑn tomɑ.
Domi tɔmbun woodɑwɑ yɑ kuɑ ben sɔ̃ɔsiru.”

content: Ye yɑ tɔnu mɔ̀ disiɡii
Mɑ Yesu u tɔn wɔru sokɑ u nɛɛ, i nɔɔwɔ kpɑ i de n bɛɛ yeeri.
N ǹ mɔ ye yɑ dumɔ tɔnun nɔɔ sɔɔ yerɑ yɑ nùn mɔ̀ disiɡii, mɑ n kun mɔ ye yɑ yɑrimɔ sɑɑ win nɔɔn di, yeyɑ yɑ rɑ tɔnu ko disiɡii.
Yerɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ nɑ win mi bɑ nɛɛ, n ǹ ɑ yɛ̃ mɑ ɡɑri yi ɑ ɡeruɑ mi, yi Fɑlisibɑ duɑwɑ mi yɑ.
U bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, dɑ̃ru bɑɑtere te nɛn Bɑɑbɑ wɔrukoo kun duure bɑ koo tu wukɑwɑ.
I bu derio. Swɑɑ ɡbio wɔ̃kobɑ. Wɔ̃ko ù n mɑɑ win wɔ̃kosi swɑɑ ɡbiiye be yiru kpurowɑ bɑ koo tokoro wɔri.
Piɛɛ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ sun mɔn te tubusio.
Yesu u nɛɛ, n ǹ bɛɛn tii yeeri kɑ tɛ̃?
I ǹ yɛ̃ mɑ ye yɑ dumɔ nɔɔ sɔɔ kpuro nukurɔwɑ yɑ dɔɔ? Mɑ ǹ n sosi yɑ koo yɑri wɑsin di.
Adɑmɑ ye yɑ yɑrimɔ nɔɔn di, ɡɔ̃run diyɑ yɑ wee. Yeyɑ yɑ rɑ tɔnu ko disiɡii.
Domi ɡɔ̃run diyɑ bwisiku kɔ̃sunu wee, kɑ tɔn ɡoberu, kɑ sɑkɑrɑru, kɑ kɔ̃ɔ mɛnnɑbu tɑntɑnɑru sɔɔ kɑ ɡbɛnɑ kɑ weesu kɑ tɔn sɑnkubu.
Yeyɑ mi, ye yɑ rɑ tɔnu ko disiɡii. Adɑmɑ nɔm kɛsɛnun dibu ku rɑ tɔnu ko disiɡii.
Kurɔ sɔɔ ɡoo u Yesu
nɑɑnɛ doke
Yen biru Yesu doonɑ min di u dɑ Tiri kɑ Sidonin berɑ ɡiɑ.
Kurɔ Kɑnɑniɡii ɡoo wi u wɑ̃ɑ berɑ mi, u nɑ win mi, mɑ u nɔɔɡiru suɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni, Dɑfidin sikɑdobu, ɑ nɛn wɔnwɔndu wɑɑwo. Nɛn bii tɔn kurɔ u wɛrɛkunu mɔ nu nùn nɔni sɔ̃ɔwɑ too.
Kɑ mɛ, Yesu kun nùn ɡɑri ɡɛɛ wisɑ. Mɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ nɑ win mi, bɑ nùn kɑnɑ u de kurɔ wi, u doonɑ min di domi u kuuki mɔ̀ u kɑ bu swĩi biruɔ.
U bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, Isirelibɑ tɔnɑn miyɑ bɑ mɑn ɡɔrimɑ be, be bɑ kɔ̃ɔre nɡe yɑ̃ɑnu.
Adɑmɑ kurɔ wi, u nɑ Yesun wuswɑɑɔ u yiirɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni, ɑ mɑn somiɔ.
Yesu nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, n ǹ weenɛ bu bibun dĩɑnu suɑ bu bɔ̃nu kɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Kurɔ wi nɛɛ, ɡeemɑ, Yinni. Kɑ mɛ, bɔ̃nu rɑ dĩɑ buri di yi yi wɔrumɑ nin yinnibun tɑbulun di.
Yerɑ Yesu nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kurɔ wunɛ, wunɛn nɑɑnɛ dokebu kpɑ̃ too. N koo nun kuɑ nɡe mɛ ɑ kĩ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, mɑ kurɔ win bii wi, u bɛkurɑ.
Yesu u bɑrɔ dɑbinu bɛkiɑ
Yesu u doonɑ min di u dɑ Gɑlilen dɑɑ burerun ɡoorɔ. Mɑ u yɔɔwɑ ɡuuru wɔllɔ u sinɑ.
Yerɑ tɔn wɔru ɡunɑ nɑ win mi. Bɑ kɑ yɛmɔbu nɑ kɑ wɔ̃kobu kɑ ɑlebuɡibu kɑ sosobu, kɑ kpɑm bɑrɔ dɑbinu bɑ yi Yesun wuswɑɑɔ, mɑ u bu bɛkiɑ.
Biti bɑkɑ tɔn be mwɑ ye bɑ wɑ sosobɑ ɡɑri mɔ̀, ɑlebuɡibɑ bɛkurɑ, yɛmɔbɑ sĩimɔ, wɔ̃kobɑ yɑm wɑɑmɔ, mɑ bɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni siɑrɑbu wɔri.
Yesu u tɔmbu nɔrɔbun
subɑ nnɛ diisiɑ

Yesu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sokɑ u nɛɛ, tɔn benin wɔnwɔndɑ mɑn mɔ̀. Yen sɔ̃ɔ itɑ wee ye bɑ kɑ wɑ̃ɑ nɛn mi, ɡɑ̃ɑnu kun mɑɑ bu tie ni bɑ koo di. Nɑ ǹ mɑɑ kĩ n bu kɑrɑ kɑ ɡɔ̃ɔru kpɑ bu ku rɑɑ dɑm biɑ swɑɑɔ bu wɔri.
Win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mɑnɑ sɑ ko sere dĩɑnu wɑ ɡbɑburu sɔɔ mini ni nu koo tɔn dɑbi teni debu.
Yesu bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, pɛ̃ɛ nyewɑ i sere mɔ. Mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, wɑsi nɔɔbɑ yiru kɑ swɛ̃ɛ piiminu ɡɑnu.
Yesu u tɔn wɔru ɡe sinɑsiɑ temɔ.
Mɑ u pɛ̃ɛ nɔɔbɑ yiru ye suɑ kɑ swɛ̃ɛ yi, u Gusunɔ siɑrɑ mɑ u mururɑ u win bwɑ̃ɑbu wɛ̃ bɑ tɔn wɔru ɡe yɑbuɑ.
Be kpuro bɑ di bɑ debɑ. Ye bɑ di n tiɑ bɑ ɡure birenu nɔɔbɑ yiru sɔɔ bɑ kɑ doonɑ.
Be bɑ ye di ben ɡeerɑ turɑ tɔnu nɔrɔbun subɑ nnɛ (4.000), tɔn kurɔbu kɑ bibu bɑɑsi.
Ye u tɔn wɔru ɡe yɑrinɑsiɑ u kpɑ, u ɡoo nimkuu duɑ u dɑ Mɑɡɑdɑn tem ɡiɑ.
